description: Remove Halo pass: Topaz Video AI Artemis (Strong Halo) run at 1:1 (no resolution change) between Remove Blur and upscale, to remove ringing/halo artifacts from oversharpened DVD sources. Originally the 2nd pass of a captured Iris -> Artemis GUI stack (2nd enhancement = Artemis, Input condition = Strong Halo, Recover detail = 100); the Iris pass now lives in deblur.json as its own stage. Parameters match the real ffmpeg.exe command line Topaz Video AI ran, not a literal reading of the GUI sliders.
_note_recover_detail: alqs-2 exposes no detail/noise AVOptions in the captured command at all, despite 'Recover detail = 100' being set in the GUI.
purpose: Removes ringing/halo outlines around hard edges, typical of oversharpened DVD masters.
_note_resize_flags: Matches the captured command line exactly. Harmless here since the final resize target equals the source's own dimensions (no scale change) -- lanczos-vs-bicubic only matters when actually resampling to different dimensions.

encoder._note: Matches deinterlace.py's mezzanine encode settings (cq=14) rather than a final-delivery preset's cq -- this stage's output feeds into upscale.py next, not the end user.
